'''Nabat Valla''' was a [[Color/Legends|red-skinned]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] information broker.

He carried a [[Sporting blaster/Legends|sporting blaster]], and wore expensive adornments and robes.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Nabat Valla is described in the ''[[State of the Arts|Star Wars Galaxies Update]]'' article in [[Star Wars Gamer 3|''Star Wars Gamer'' 3]]. He is concept art for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.
